race.comment: GRAMMAR LAD (9) returns and has trialled sharply in readiness, stripping fitter for two at Deagon. Contested what proved to be some hot form references during the winter carnival and is 1/1 over the track and trip. Bright return anticipated. LA ROJA (5) also resumes and shoulders some net form references too, most notably flashing home in the LR Eye Liner Stakes when beaten a neck. Has been readied with two trials for the new yard and can make the perfect start for them. BEREZKA (10) is rock-hard fit and ticking along beautifully. Can get involved in the finish with a clever steer. STREET CHASE (3) came up just short when resuming at the midweeks. Has kept the legs ticking over with a trial 38 days between runs, and if he's taken natural improvement he can give this a shake. NOBLE DECREE (12) was thereabouts throughout last prep without striking. Two solid lead-up trials and a light weight give him a sniff.
